text:
kevin: Quick UX review — exploring a compact 'spend ribbon' (horizontal summary bar) vs a collapsible 'segment drawer' for the Usage page. Posting mock + questions. pls react :eyes:

anya: Love the ribbon for at-a-glance. Concern: how does it scale with many projects?

maria: If ribbon shows top 3 metrics, we could add a chevron that expands to full panel. Keeps density low.

sam: Performance note: any expansions should avoid reloading the heavy chart bundle. Prefer client-side reveal.

olivia: Sketch + copy suggestions:
- ribbon label: "Current period spend" (instead of just "Spend")
- CTA: "Download invoice" vs "Invoice" — explicit verb is clearer for accessibility.

kevin: Good call on verbs. Also thinking about scope — should ribbon represent org total or the active project? Toggle?

anya: UX preference: ribbon shows the active scope by default, with a subtle "Scope: org | project" chip. Clicking chip opens segment drawer for cross-scope compare.

maria: Implementation idea: keep token breakdown small: token icon + numeric + percent. Clicking that tile opens a mini-modal with token line-item breakdown and export action.

sam: Dev caveat: mini-modal is fine, but modals stack poorly on mobile. For mobile, we should expand inline below ribbon.

kevin: Accessibility nits: aria-labels for the scope chip, and aria-expanded for the ribbon chevron. Also ensure color contrast for the small sparkline.

olivia: Copy tweak: instead of "Token usage", use "Token breakdown (by model)" when expanded — helps set expectation.

anya: Layout question: do we want a persistent download anchor in the ribbon (fast path) or keep it within the drawer (contextual)?

maria: Persistent anchor is higher discoverability but adds visual weight. Maybe keep a lightweight icon-only button with tooltip "Download CSV".

kevin: Sounds good. Can we try a micro-variant: ribbon with icon-only download + scope chip, and drawer for deeper controls (date range, invoice download, per-project toggles)?

sam: Approve technically. Need final ARIA strings before dev handoff.

olivia: I'll push updated Figma with two variants: "ribbon-lite" and "ribbon+drawer". Link: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/spend-ribbon-proposals

billing-bot: New invoice export (CSV) feature flagged for org:billing-export. Enabled in staging.

kevin: Great — @olivia please drop the copy and ARIA strings here when ready, and @maria will prototype the icon-only download. We'll review tomorrow 10am PT. :calendar:
